findings.claim: A registered local command ledger can still be published through a non-aso schema publication after a schema move.
findings.evidence: The guard rejected the literal aso schema and explicit pg_publication_rel membership, but did not compare registered relation namespaces with pg_publication_namespace.
findings.suggested_fix: Join registered relation OIDs through pg_class.relnamespace to publication namespaces and add schema-move tests.

findings.claim: TRUNCATE can remove QA results or claim mappings supporting approved and signed letters without invoking either immutability guard.
findings.evidence: The QA and claim guards were row triggers for INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE only; no statement-level TRUNCATE trigger existed.
findings.suggested_fix: Add BEFORE TRUNCATE guards and negative integration tests.

findings.claim: The hook permits a new reassessment while a prior command outcome remains unknown and silently discards the only reconciliation identifier.
findings.evidence: The duplicate guard checked only the in-flight ref; the uncertain path cleared it while retaining lastCommandId, and the next mutation reset lastCommandId. use-surgeon-gate had the same state pattern.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the unresolved command slot until successful lookup or track multiple unresolved commands; add 503-then-second-command tests.
